title: Coconut Tree Enemies EXPOSED! Red Palm Weevil & Rhinoceros beetle ചെമ്പൻ ചെല്ലി കൊമ്പൻ ചെല്ലി
description:
Coconut trees look strong and healthy—but two deadly insects can destroy them silently from the inside.
In this video, we uncover the Red Palm Weevil (Rhynchophorus ferrugineus) and the Coconut Rhinoceros Beetle (Oryctes rhinoceros)—the most dangerous pests threatening coconut palms across Asia and beyond.

🔍 In this video, you’ll learn:

How the Red Palm Weevil attacks and kills coconut trees from inside

How the Rhinoceros Beetle damages young and mature palms

Early warning signs farmers often miss

Life cycle, behavior, and real damage caused by these insects

Why these pests are a serious threat to coconut farming

🌴 Whether you are a farmer, student, or nature enthusiast, this video will help you understand how these insects work and why early awareness is critical.

👉 Watch till the end to see why these beetles are called silent killers of coconut trees.
